descriptor: A boot-to-launch pre-release for a new operating system

voice.summary: Talks in command-line English: lowercase, clipped, with the odd dry joke. It treats the visitor as someone who prefers typing to clicking.
dos: Write messages like system output, one line each
Use verbs a shell would: boot, notify, launch
donts: No full paragraphs inside the terminal

boilerplate: Parsec OS is a forthcoming operating system for people who live in the terminal, previewed through a retro boot sequence and a countdown to launch.

microcopy.success: ok: you are on the list
microcopy.error: error: command not found, type help

logo.note: Stacked chevrons echo a shell prompt, the first thing a terminal fan looks for.
